instagram.caption:
Florida just pulled $200 million meant for EV chargers and put it toward air taxi landing pads instead. ✈️

Electric planes don't plug into parking lots — they need dedicated real estate to land and take off. So the state is betting on pads, not plugs, to change how you get to the airport.

Your next commute could end at a local pad, not a terminal gate.

Is your city on the planned landing pad map? 📍
